case: Sunday: "this week" asked on the week's last day is the coming week

parts.quote: What is on for the family this week?

answers.text: Monday has Practise reading for Leo, Tuesday has Parents' evening for Mara and Tom and Sign the school trip form for Mara, and Wednesday has Football training for Ivy. Thursday has Swimming lesson for Leo and Piano lesson for Ivy, Friday has Dinner at Nona Marija's, and Saturday has U13 match, Olimpija for Ivy.
